name: Ianane III
description: Ianane III was a Wild Space planet whose surface was completely covered by a deep layer of sand. The planet had violent storms in its atmosphere, and the brightness of its surface for a long time caused it to be misidentified as a star. Ianane III was orbited by the ruins of the Ianane Ring, believed to be constructed by the long-disappeared Celestials.
